title: Puharich jokes on tape about being a double agent for Israel

tellings.quote: um, he he kind of jokingly says, "Oh, I'm an I'm I'm a I'm a double agent

plain: Andrija Puharich, a doctor who researched psychic powers, is heard on one of his own tape recordings joking, "Oh, I'm a double agent," in connection with Israel. Greg Malatzi, a researcher who has listened to Puharich's tapes, tells Michels about it and stresses the tone was joking, so it hints at, but does not settle, whether Puharich worked for more than one country.
